sections.strategic_report: STRATEGIC REPORT FOR THE YEAR ENDED 30 SEPTEMBER 2025 \- 1 - The directors present the strategic report for the year ended 30 September 2025. Overview Financial Year 2024-2025 was a period of continued scale, R&D acceleration, and strategic positioning for Informed Group. Building on foundational investment, the business has continued to successfully pursue a dynamic innovation path, making operational and commercial foundations more resilient and ensuring stability, productivity, profitability, and sustained growth throughout the period. Our operating model – blending high-performing in-house talent with a robust B2B partner ecosystem has proven both scalable and resilient, enabling sustained growth despite a challenging political and economic backdrop, exacerbated by geopolitical instability. Financial highlights include maintaining record revenue achieved over the 2023-2024 period alongside sustained gross margins, driven by a 20% increase in staff headcount. The addition and mobilisation of several high-profile, long-term contracts, alongside successful diversification and growth in volume of Informed’s client base, have secured a healthy forward delivery pipeline for the 2025-2026 period. Operationally, the business has increased delivery capacity and capability to meet the continued demand from national-scale customers. Informed’s headcount increase has been realised through the continuing success of the business’s graduate recruitment programme, alongside the addition of high-quality, experienced professionals, which have ensured both the successful 100% retention of clients and significant client estate growth through the effective onboarding of a significant number of new nationally significant customers operating in both Public and Private Sector markets. Significant positive cash flow has been used to increase investment in workspace for the business’s growing employee base, as well as to fund a dynamic research and development programme that has resulted in new Artificial Intelligence (AI) and advanced data science intellectual property assets and capabilities, which continue to accelerate domestic and international growth. Increased investment in product and service diversification has strengthened both the profile and uptake of InformedDECISION™, a first-of-its-kind Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Natural Language Processing (NLP) platform that allows organisations to make better, faster, more informed decisions. Alongside this, InformedINSIGHT™, an open-standards-based data integration and analytics platform that enables organisations to turn data science into real-world decision support, was funded through a Civtech Innovation challenge and was rolled out nationally for operational use by the Scottish Government. Following the change of Government in mid-2024, the business successfully navigated the slowdown in public sector procurement in the first two quarters by strengthening its focus on private-sector business development with strong customer growth in the transport sector. Through the second half, the business added significant public sector clients from central Government and Environment and Land Management, pharmaceutical and healthcare, and a growing base of regulators operating across policing and healthcare. The business continues to view the global digital skills shortage as an opportunity to invest in domestic and international skills development through our world-class ISO-accredited InformedACADEMY™ learning and development framework. This framework has been extended to include artificial intelligence and data science modules, which are increasingly attractive in domestic and international markets. InformedACADEMY™ has been further expanded to present our people, clients, and partners with accelerated career development and commercial growth opportunities. The business has continued to focus on an enhanced people engagement strategy, which has seen us recognised as a certified GREAT Place to Work® for a fifth year running, with employees giving an average recommendation rating of 85% across 22 key workplace criteria. International trade and market development are central to Informed’s growth ambitions. The business has invested in recruiting in-country leadership in Malaysia alongside an International Engagement Lead based in the UK. Informed has grown and strengthened its alliance partner ecosystem and network of associates and subcontractors, enabling commercial activities to support domestic and international growth through the 2025-2026 period and beyond. THE INFORMED GROUP LIMITED CHAIR'S STATEMENT AND STRATEGIC REPORT (CONTINUED) FOR THE YEAR ENDED 30 SEPTEMBER 2025 \- 2 - Overview - continued Based on the business’s proven ability to deliver high-impact, trust-based innovation for critical national infrastructure, Informed was invited to participate in the UK-Ukraine Tech Bridge, supported by the Department for Business and Trade. This programme has led to engagement with European partners and prospects, with growth prospects for the 2025-2026 period. Our Business Progress The business invested in acquiring and developing market-leading skills and capabilities in data science, service design, and delivery management disciplines. Over the 2024-2025 period, we have continued to prioritise skills development in Artificial Intelligence (AI), Natural Language Processing (NLP), Machine Learning (ML), geospatial and location intelligence, DevOps, DevSecOps, MLOps, WebOps, and Continuous integration methods, all of which are in increasing demand from existing and potential clients both in domestic and international markets. The business has continued to invest in significant internal improvement initiatives, further enhancing productivity and business success.
